_comment_silhouette: Fahran whole-world relief map with a blue-DOMINANT (but brightness-varying) ocean. kind=blue_sea keys on hue not distance (an 80+ blue-channel gradient defeats flat_sea); frame_dark drops the black border/letterbox; the exclude box drops the bottom-left attribution text. Land 0.366 vs mask 0.369, so land/sea is balanced and the coarse silhouette IoU locks globally (unlike the land-heavy regional tiles).
_comment_coarse: Whole-world map filling the canvas: full scale ~ (8192/1680, 3616/1214) = (4.9, 3.0), independent per axis because the source aspect (1.38) differs from the canvas Miller aspect (2.27) — that projection/aspect gap is real and the lattice absorbs the residual. Reduced units: src_step 2, canvas_step 8, so full_scale = reduced*4.
_comment_lattice: 12x8 over the whole world (~140 master px spacing). The coarse-stage refine gets bigger reach (radii to 192) so the NW/E/mid-east regions are pulled inward to the coast, not just the well-placed centre; kept to single passes + a fast narrowed coarse so the fit completes within the run budget.
_comment_landmarks: Source px on the Fahran map; anchor px on terraqueous_globe.jpg (pushed to canvas via its NE-II fit). Held-out check only (the silhouette drives the fit). Major landmasses, rough picks acceptable for a check.
